title: Get Involved
body: There are many ways to make a difference in the lives of our veterans and neighbors. Together, we can bring hope, practical help, and lasting change.

deck.title: Volunteer
deck.subtitle: Give you time and talents on the front lines or behind the scenes

deck.title: Partner with VJO
deck.subtitle: Join us as a ministry, business, or organization to expand our impact.

deck.title: Donate Supplies
deck.subtitle: Help meet real needs with clothing, hygiene items, food, and more.

deck.title: Pray With Us
deck.subtitle: Lift up our veterans, our team, and the people we serve.
